query:
INSERT INTO transfers (
                amount,
                sender,
                receiver,
                memo,
                source
            )
            VALUES ($1::bigint, $2, $3, $4, $5)
            RETURNING
                id,
                CAST(amount AS BIGINT) as "amount!",
                sender,
                receiver,
                memo,
                EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM created_at)::BIGINT AS "created_at!",
                source as "source!: TransferSource"
